D1.quote: email_compose action reply on the latest message from the person you address (a reply goes to its sender), reply_all false, Cc set explicitly (OUTSIDE MAIL), Cc you; that person never wrote on it (a new contact after a handover): draft action reply on the thread's latest message, draft update to set To and Cc, read it back, draft send. Either way include_signature false, no link, idempotency_key "loopin:<the thread's latest Message-ID>"; a loop-in Activity already on this thread: send none. ... We wrote last: to the current contact (read the thread and any later mail from that agency for a handover; ...)
D1.schema_check: email_compose: 'to' is 'Send and forward only: a reply goes to the original sender'; 'cc' has no such limit, so a reply takes Cc. Replying on the contact's own (older) message puts them in To, never ad@. draft: 'to' is 'Not for reply: a reply draft goes to the original sender ... an update can change it afterwards'; update 'change only the fields you pass'; send 'needs a to/cc/bcc'. So the draft path can retarget To away from ad@. Both branches reach the person whose move it is and never put Akshay in To.
D1.residual: See N1 and N2 (draft path idempotency and leftovers).

N1.defect: 'Either way include_signature false, no link, idempotency_key "loopin:<...>"' reads as one key for every call of the draft path (draft reply, draft update, draft send). The schema says a key is 'reuse only for the identical call within 24h; it runs once'. Reusing it on the send can return the cached reply-draft result (nothing sent, but logged as sent) or be refused.
N1.fix: Put the key only on the call that sends: email_compose reply, or draft send. Draft reply and update take no key (or 'loopin-draft:<...>').

N2.defect: Draft path failure (update or send fails, or the read-back shows ad@ still in To) leaves a loop-in draft in Akshay's Drafts. Nothing is logged, so the next run makes a second draft; Akshay could send the leftover by hand, giving a double loop-in. On IMAP the draft_id also changes after update; the prompt doesn't say to use the new one.
N2.fix: 'Use the draft_id each draft call returns; on any failure or a wrong read-back, draft delete and report it. Before a draft reply, draft_list: a draft on this thread with the loop-in line: use it, never a second.'

N3.defect: The loop-in goes from ad@ with 'Cc set explicitly (OUTSIDE MAIL)', and OUTSIDE MAIL Cc's Akshay (ad@thepodium.in) on every mail, so the loop-in Cc's its own sender. A self-copy lands in ad@'s INBOX for the inbox routine to process. This was already in live.
N3.fix: 'On the loop-in, ad@thepodium.in is the sender: never in To or Cc.'

N4.defect: A new stakeholder People row still gets Source ID "gmail:<thread id>". MCP Emails exposes no Gmail thread id, so the model invents one or leaves it unsettled. The inbox uses msgid:<first message's Message-ID> for new rows.
N4.fix: Source ID "msgid:<the thread's first Message-ID>" (old gmail: ids stay).

N5.defect: Live 6c searched '-in:sent -in:spam -in:trash'. The new 'Search ad@thepodium.in (MAILBOX)' takes MAILBOX's default folders, which include sent, so Akshay's own sent mail with invoices gets listed for Jaya.
N5.fix: 'Search ad@thepodium.in (MAILBOX, folders inbox and archive only)'.

N6.defect: (a) 'Never send mail (decision 420; ...), within the daily cap on ...' leaves a cap clause that now governs nothing. (b) 'Skip a message forwarded before 28 Oct (an Activity ... naming it)': the old Activities hold a Gmail id, not a Message-ID, and their Summary names only vendor and what. In the first run's 4-day window, already-forwarded docs can be listed again, so Jaya gets duplicates from Akshay.
N6.fix: (a) 'Never send mail (decision 420). Create drafts only in STEP 3d.' (b) 'Skip a message whose vendor, what and date match a forward Activity from before 28 Oct.'

N7.defect: A reply draft is followed by an update, and on IMAP 'a draft_id changes on every update'. LOGGING records 'Draft ID' without saying which, so Activities can hold a stale id.
N7.fix: MAILBOX draft clause: 'log the draft_id the last call returned'.

N8.severity: open question for Akshay (not a prompt edit)
N8.defect: Google Calendar writes on ad@'s calendar with notificationLevel ALL (delete_event for duplicates and written cancellations, update_event adding recording links or moving un# invites, create_event for invites and team bookings) make Google send mail from ad@. The README only asks this about inbox STEP 6e. These are not loop-ins.
N8.fix: Widen the README question to the batch. If Akshay counts these as allowed, record that as the 420 scope.

N9.defect: On a Gmail IMAP inbox, the 'archive' alias resolves only if a folder has that role (All Mail is \All, not \Archive). If it doesn't resolve, searches fail or skip archived mail. The same recipe is in the inbox build, and replay2 there may already cover it.
N9.fix: Run folder_list on cd37e47e once. If 'archive' doesn't resolve, name '[Gmail]/All Mail'.
